idea.title: 4 questions to ask before booking a viewing
idea.angle: Qualify budget, location, timeline and decision-maker so viewings aren't wasted
idea.hook: A wasted viewing costs you a morning. Four questions prevent most of them.

slides.heading: 4 questions to ask **before** you book a viewing
A viewing is **not free**
slides.body: Fuel, Accra traffic, a lost morning. If the buyer can't afford it or isn't ready, that time is gone. A few questions first protect it.

slides.heading: Ask about **budget**
slides.body: Send: 'So I show you the right options, what budget range are you working with?' Then match listings to the answer, not the hope.

slides.heading: Ask about **location**
slides.body: Send: 'Which areas work for you, and is there anywhere you'd rather avoid?' Lekki Phase 1 and Ajah are very different conversations.

slides.heading: Ask about **timing**
slides.body: Send: 'When are you hoping to move in?' Next month and next year are both fine. They just need different follow-up.

slides.heading: Ask who **decides**
slides.body: Send: 'Will anyone else be part of the decision? Happy to have them at the viewing too.' Saves a second trip for the spouse.

slides.heading: AI only qualifies well when someone teaches it **the right questions.**
Save this for your **next enquiry**

caption:
A wasted viewing costs you a morning. Four questions prevent most of them.

Budget: so you only show what they can buy.
Location: so you don't drive across town for nothing.
Timeline: so you know how hard to follow up.
Decision-maker: so the real buyer is in the room.

The same goes for any chatbot answering your DMs. It only qualifies well if the right questions are built into it.
